reviews.text:
I’m writing to warn everyone about “Kendra’s Pet Setting.” I’m really upset and feel compelled to share this on Facebook! I had a great experience with her last year, and she took care of my pups perfectly. So, we booked her again in January, paying in advance to have her watch my dogs this weekend. When we arrived, she wasn’t there, and she didn’t answer my calls! She only got in touch last week to confirm the dates. My husband and I are on a 7-hour drive down south for a family event, which makes this even more frustrating.
I’ve included the messages, the paid invoice, and her business information below. Please be cautious and don’t book with her! Also, I’m filing a police report.
You should be ashamed of yourself Kendra! Send me my money back asap!
****Police report has been filed****
Kendra’s Pet Sitting

Do not use this pet service. The owner is a thief. She was supposed to be buying a pet cage from me for $50 which was originally 75 but I was willing to give it to her for cheap. I was out of town so I told her they could pick it up and Zelle me the money. She told me after talking to her all day that she may get it from someone closer that had it cheaper. When I went home and checked my cameras, her husband had picked it up. You can tell he didn’t know he was stealing it because he was in my driveway, strapping it down and everything. So it looks to me like she even told her husband that she was paying for it, but didn’t. According to timestamps, she had already picked it up when she told me that she may get it from someone else. Well, I have cameras everywhere and I sent her evidence explaining that she needed to send me my money or bring the cage back. She has blocked me from her Facebook and I’m sure from texting her. Because I never got a reply. So I sent her the information from a different phone and I’ve still not Yet. So unless you want to support someone that steals from other people. And don’t get me wrong it’s not about the money at this point it’s the principal. I cannot stand a thief. It has been verified that it was her husband. So please don’t support this company

Had my dog here for daycare for a week & after the week i would not recommend it. She is overpriced and charges the same as The Blue Dog House which i’m sure is a more professional setting than she is. I do like how her hours are flexible, however her professionalism was not good nor was the service. She doesn’t send updates about how the dog is doing, not even for the first day(even though before I had even booked with her, I asked her if she would send updates and pictures and she said yes).I had messaged her on my dogs first day to get an update after i hadn’t received one after having dropped off my dog for a few hours and she didn’t answered me for over an hour & it seemed like i had been blocked. It wasn’t until i had someone else message her that i got a response back, not a very good look for the first day . On one of the days i picked up my dog, they had messed with his harness so it was hanging completely off his side which is so unprofessional when it didn’t need to be fixed and they didn’t even bother to fix the loosening they had done that made the harness unwearable for my dog during pickup. I waited over half an hour past the agreed pickup time (agreed time was 10pm & i got there a few minutes earlier before 10pm  & didn’t get my dog until around  10:33. i waited so long after constant knocking , messaging her that i was there & calling her because no one would come to the door or reply back)& when i arrived for pickup, the bag that i drop off containing my dogs food and things was outside sitting on a chair for who knows how long & sometimes she doesn’t always respond in a timely manner. I would recommend you go to an actual daycare or boarding facility where they will be more professional and actually worth the price. For how Kendra’s services are, her dog prices should be wayyyy lower than the price she’s charging, not to mention i’m sure she stole the prices off of The Blue Dog House and had i known that she preferred me to walk up to the door every time i would’ve been she never complained and i figured she preferred car door pickup & drop off since i didn’t receive a message about her rules & policies for that.

Kendra made me feel right at home and super comfortable leaving my 8-month old puppy and 6 week old kitten with her and her family. The family is so sweet and neighborhood so friendly. If I lived in the Houston area, I’d want to live in that neighborhood. Kendra is super-responsive and even left us with a going away gift/goodie bag! Customer/Family service was the best! I will 💯% contact her again when I’m in Houston. She made everything so easy. Thanks for taking care of us, Kendra!❤️ I also wish I could give more stars than just the five.
Truly caring and reliable—Kendra treats Acey like family. He’s always so excited when we drop him off, and we have complete peace of mind the whole time.
Glad she look over Onyx she did a great job, will take him again

Kendra was wonderful with my dog, I felt safe knowing he was in good hands and worked with me on the day I needed him to be boarded in Texas. I will be a return customer and I’m so glad for her services!

Kendra is an amazing person. Just wanted to say thank you so much. I wish I can give you more stars because it was well worth it. Amazing with pricing and especially knowing that your Pet is Well, taken care of…thank you God bless you. Highly recommended.
She was great with Star baby, even worked with me on having to keep her a extra night cause of a canceled flight so couldn't make it to pick her up in time.
